subject.title: fix(tui): deduplicate assistant messages across sessions.changed reload

question: Should maintainers accept this TUI runId surrender contract for sessions.changed new/reset reload races?
rationale: The code path intentionally changes when late assistant deltas/finals are rendered or suppressed after history reloads, so green CI cannot alone decide whether that session/message-state contract is the desired owner behavior.

options.title: Accept the surrender contract
options.body: Merge after required checks because the event-handler boundary avoids ChatLog text heuristics and the current head covers the known finalized and in-flight late-event cases.

options.title: Ask for native visual proof first
options.body: Pause merge until a maintainer or contributor adds a native Telegram/TUI recording that shows one visible assistant reply for the original external-channel flow.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Send the PR back if maintainers want finalized late finals to remain renderable after reload or want the behavior owned in history replay instead of event handling.

recommendation.title: Accept the surrender contract
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks because the event-handler boundary avoids ChatLog text heuristics and the current head covers the known finalized and in-flight late-event cases.
